data.name: Psychedelia
data.description: You ingest hallucinogens to expand your mind. Experimentation and study show you which ones will have the greatest effect. Your psychedelic forays put you into a different mental space from others, and normal people don't really understand you. Phrenic Pool Ability: Wisdom. Discipline Powers: You distort your own mind and perceptions, and can impress your altered states onto others.
